item.title: The field is set: Meet the candidates officially running for California governor
item.description: Eight Democrats and two Republicans have filed officially to run for California governor by the Friday deadline. The crowded field could give GOP candidates a boost.

item.title: ICE surge in Minneapolis parallels California gang database debacle
item.description: ICE agents arrest people based on looks or skin color, as police in California did years ago when databases falsely listed many as gang members.

item.title: California has 40,000 affordable housing units ready to break ground. One setback is holding them up
item.description: Tens of thousands of affordable units across California are stuck in financial purgatory, according to a new report. Will more money get them moving?

item.title: It was John Wayne’s political club. Now it’s spending millions on online influence
item.description: The Lincoln Media Foundation has spent big to push ‘local’ conservative messaging

item.title: California’s elderly parole program makes sense for inmates ‘aging out of crime’
item.description: Less than 2% of elderly parolees reoffend. Those with sex offenses must register and often get treatment and wear a monitor.

item.title: After his crash killed a child, the DMV renewed his license – then it hid his records
item.description: ‘There is either moral culpability or legal liability on them,' the Placer County DA said, 'and they are actively seeking to prevent that from being disclosed.'

item.title: After his crash killed a child, the DMV renewed his license — then it hid his records
item.description: I’m CalMatters reporter Mikhail Zinshteyn and I’m subbing in for Lynn today. item.title: Conozca a los candidatos que se postulan oficialmente para gobernador de California
item.description: Ocho demócratas y dos republicanos han presentado oficialmente su candidatura a gobernador de California antes de la fecha límite del viernes. La amplia candidatura podría impulsar a los candidatos republicanos.

item.title: Some State Farm customers could see refunds while homeowner rate hikes stay put
item.description: State Farm reaches settlement over emergency insurance rate hikes after last year’s Los Angeles County fires.

item.title: California cut health care for undocumented immigrants. One lawmaker wants it back
item.description: California Democrats introduced legislation to restore Medi-Cal for all income-qualifying residents of any age, including undocumented immigrants. Gov. Newsom scaled back that program because of state budget deficits.
